load_model_dinov2: load a pretrained DINOv2 model from torch hub and return the wrapped model, preprocessor, and info
create_dinov2_backbone: create a Detectron2 DINOv2 backbone with configurable layer unfreezing and cross-view attention
run_forward_intermediates: run forward intermediates on a DINO model to extract normalized features from selected transformer blocks
normalize_input_images: normalize input image tensors using registered mean and standard deviation buffers
convert_tokens_to_output: convert dense and cls tokens to cls, gap, dense, or dense-cls output formats
